description: This file contains logging setup and utility functions for the blivet-gui project, including configuring loggers, unpacking user input for logging, and logging utility calls.

methods.name: set_logging
methods.description: Configures logging for a specified component, setting up a rotating file handler if the log directory is writable.

methods.name: _unpack_input
methods.description: Recursively unpacks user input (list, dict, or StorageDevice) into a message string and collects involved StorageDevice instances.

methods.name: log_utils_call
methods.description: Logs a utility call, including user input and involved devices, handling exceptions to prevent crashes.
